purpose: Close remaining-backend inventory gaps, not assert migration completeness.

methodology.source: Pinned GitHub repository tree and 69 licensed .cs/.csproj files, excluding migrations/resources. No SoSYS requests.
methodology.counts: Static HTTP verb attributes, registered RPC service classes, DbSet declarations and scheduled job registrations. These are not exact API or feature totals. Framework conventions, derived actions, conditional routes, DTO constraints and middleware behavior require separate runtime contract validation.
methodology.authorization: Read-only public-source inspection; no production accounts, payments, credential creation, external requests from application code, or persistent changes executed.

contracts.known: Dyson auth plus authentication/authorization and RemotePermissionMiddleware. Controllers add owner/developer/member and permission checks. Custom-app secrets, bot keys and their rotation are separate privileged workflows.
contracts.unknown: Shared middleware implementation, PermissionKeys wire strings, token/session claims and generated auth-client contracts. Inventory names are not authorization to generate or rotate real credentials.

contracts.known: Program registers Sphere, Account, Drive and Wallet services. Startup also registers DyProfileService at https://_grpc.passport and DyAuthorizedAppService at https://_grpc.stargate.
contracts.unknown: Service discovery/TLS behavior and shared protobuf schemas need a separately permitted contract source.

contracts.known: PostgreSQL/Npgsql with dynamic JSON, NodaTime, snake_case names, split queries, soft-delete/auditing. Unique (AppId,Key) board-widget and PluginId miniapp indices; app-product/state one-to-one. MiniAppStorageService uses Minio-compatible object storage, ZIP manifest inspection and SHA-256 metadata, a 5MiB package cap and an additional 64KiB multipart allowance.
contracts.unknown: Production S3 configuration/credentials and existing data are intentionally not read. Shared ModelBase auditing/soft-delete lifecycle is not ported.

contracts.known: Startup registers FileMetadataReferenceListener<AppDatabase>. No Quartz jobs are registered in inspected Develop startup files.
contracts.unknown: The inherited file event envelope and delivery semantics are in shared code; absence of a local registration is not proof no external scheduler invokes the service.

contracts.known: Licensed source contains Afdian, AppleStore and Paddle provider handlers, checkout/order-restore/webhook controller methods, subscription catalog policy, gifts and wallet products. PaymentOrderEvent handler branches on gift_id, subscription_id, app_subscription and wallet_product with JetStream max retries 3.
contracts.unknown: Production provider configuration, account entitlements, external contract currentness, money-rounding guarantees across services, event idempotency and complete webhook/runtime interoperability are not established by this inventory. No payment flow was executed.

contracts.known: 15 DbSets cover wallets, pockets, orders/inbound orders, transactions, transfer requests, funds/recipients, subscriptions/catalog, gifts/coupons/order items, merchants/settlements. PostgreSQL/NodaTime/dynamic JSON, snake_case names and inherited auditing/soft-delete are configured.
contracts.unknown: Shared model definitions and currency/enum constants require separately licensed sources. Transaction isolation, duplicate-event behavior, cross-service ordering, financial invariants and recovery parity require dedicated implementation and tests.

contracts.known: AppDatabaseRecycling and AppSettlement daily at 00:00; SubscriptionRenewal every 30 minutes; GiftCleanup and FundExpiration hourly; TransactionExpiration and FundRaisingDeadline every 15 minutes. Hosted LegacyInAppSubscriptionAvailabilityValidationService also exists.
contracts.unknown: Scheduler timezone, multi-replica coordination and restart/retry execution guarantees need runtime/config verification.

contracts.known: Program registers Dyson auth, Account, Ring, Drive, Develop and Sphere; 5 mapped gRPC service classes. Wallet JSON uses snake_case property/dictionary keys, NodaTime and named floating literals; gRPC send/receive limits are 16MiB.
contracts.unknown: Generated protobuf descriptors, shared authentication/permission contracts and remote service deployment routing.

blockers_and_nonblockers.inspectable_work: All 69 selected Wallet/Develop source files were retrievable and are under the verified root license. Their remaining service behavior is inspectable work, not an access blocker.
blockers_and_nonblockers.blocked_reuse: Separately versioned shared-submodule implementation is not licensed by assumption. Resolve its independent licensing/access or derive interfaces from permitted specifications and licensed callers.
blockers_and_nonblockers.not_inspected: Migrations/resources, appsettings/config secrets, real provider accounts, deployed data or runtime behavior. No unlicensed repository implementation was copied or translated.
blockers_and_nonblockers.implementation_status: This task adds inventory only. Board work elsewhere and existing Go counterparts must be reconciled by the lead before setting per-feature completed status.
